findings.summary: The commit message promises "Each new test fails with its fix reverted", but the new test for a completed dispatched run passes when reverted because it asserts the unmodified behavior for completed runs.

disposition.reason: a commit-message wording point, not a code defect: 'a completed dispatched run created before the head arrived does not count' is a control pinning unchanged behaviour beside the two new hold tests, which do fail with the fix reverted (verified); commit messages in this stack are not rewritten
